## b796567210ec

**Reproduced canonical-domain mismatch and narrowed lesson lattice; audit target left unchanged.** Generator SHA-256 `6812d248458fb0880d9efbc02b8bad197589ed0f5dd41e7f06515e660539eac0`; canonical rule hash `c69c59621c97` (the module does not pin it).

`self_check` rejects every canonical input with `dot is not on a valid 3x3 expansion center`. Across the three canonical pairs I counted 19 off-lattice query dots, while 600 sampled default lessons emitted none: generation restricts dots to rows `8,11,14,…` and columns `1,5,9`, although the canonical task places them at other rows and columns. One canonical pair also uses color `0` in the lookup key/block palette; 600 generated lessons used it zero times. A learner can therefore specialize to a fixed, non-overlapping lattice and a nonzero palette even though those restrictions are not properties of the authority task.

The same direct probe found `anchor_corner`, `asymmetry_force`, `include_decoy`, and `bg_color` inert at seed `123`, sample index `4`, and found unknown-key acceptance. Shared lint failed for the missing `RULE_HASH`; shared self-check reproduced rejection of all three canonical inputs while 60 default instances passed. The separate override-stage attempt was interrupted after writing a `status: running` receipt and is retained only as incomplete evidence, not as a verdict.

Evidence: `checks/audit/probe.json`; `checks/audit/stages/b796567210ec-lint/checks/b796567210ec_after_lint.log`; `checks/audit/stages/b796567210ec-selfcheck/checks/b796567210ec_after_selfcheck.log`; incomplete attempt `checks/audit/stages/b796567210ec-override/result.json`.
